pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Who chose your name in most families? (1 mark)
   A. Parents or guardians
   B. The police
   C. A shopkeeper
   D. Your teacher

2. What should you do before the day ends if you have quarrelled with a friend? (1 mark)
   A. Make peace and forgive
   B. Tell others lies about them
   C. Plan revenge
   D. Stop speaking to them

3. What is joy, as a Christian understands it? (1 mark)
   A. Having lots of money
   B. Never having problems
   C. Only laughing at jokes
   D. A deep gladness that comes from knowing God loves us

4. A child lives with a grandmother and an aunt because her parents work far away. Is this a family? (1 mark)
   A. Yes, every family that cares for a child should be respected
   B. No, only parents and children make a family
   C. No, it is only a group of neighbours
   D. Only if they are rich

5. If a child is hurt by someone, whose fault is it? (1 mark)
   A. The parents
   B. The person who did wrong
   C. The school
   D. The child

6. What is one warning sign that a situation is unsafe? (1 mark)
   A. You feel proud
   B. You feel sleepy
   C. You feel uneasy or scared
   D. You feel happy

7. Which attribute comforts a child who is lonely? (1 mark)
   A. God forgets us
   B. God is a loving Father who knows us by name
   C. God is angry
   D. God is far away

8. Which of these is a Gospel? (1 mark)
   A. Psalms
   B. Romans
   C. John
   D. Acts

9. What did Jesus say to Zacchaeus? (1 mark)
   A. Follow me to Jerusalem
   B. Go away
   C. Sell your house
   D. Come down, I must stay at your house today

10. Where was Joseph when the cupbearer remembered him? (1 mark)
   A. In his father's house
   B. In prison
   C. In Canaan
   D. In the palace

11. Which verse in Luke says that John would go before the Lord to prepare His way? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 19:5
   B. Luke 1:76
   C. Luke 7:14
   D. Luke 15:8

12. What is a miracle? (1 mark)
   A. An amazing act that shows God's power
   B. A school lesson
   C. A festival
   D. An ordinary meal

13. Which statement about forgiveness is true? (1 mark)
   A. Forgiving means the wrong was fine
   B. Forgiving means telling lies
   C. Forgiving is a sign of weakness
   D. Forgiving takes courage

14. What did Joseph say about what his brothers intended? (1 mark)
   A. You must pay
   B. You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good
   C. You must leave
   D. You are enemies

15. What does sharing at school help to build? (1 mark)
   A. Kindness and unity
   B. Jealousy
   C. Laziness
   D. Selfishness

16. Which of these is a righteous way of living? (1 mark)
   A. Stealing
   B. Cheating
   C. Lying
   D. Telling the truth

17. What rests in the branches of the tree? (1 mark)
   A. Snakes
   B. Lions
   C. Goats
   D. Birds

18. What does a seed need to grow? (1 mark)
   A. Only sand
   B. Nothing
   C. Only noise
   D. Soil, water and light

19. Which of these shows a good response to John 3:16? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring God
   B. Forgetting the verse
   C. Blaming others
   D. Believing in Jesus and thanking God

20. Which verse says that those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion? (1 mark)
   A. Psalm 125:1
   B. Luke 1:37
   C. John 3:16
   D. Genesis 1:1

21. If a stranger tries to grab you, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Give them your bag
   B. Go with them
   C. Stay silent
   D. Shout for help and run to a safe place

22. What does exaggeration mean? (1 mark)
   A. Being silent
   B. Making things sound bigger than they are
   C. Being kind
   D. Telling the exact truth

23. Which verse tells us to speak truthfully to our neighbour? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 19:5
   B. Ephesians 4:25
   C. Genesis 1:1
   D. John 3:16

24. Which action shows love? (1 mark)
   A. Teasing
   B. Ignoring
   C. Hurting
   D. Sharing your lunch

25. What does persecution mean? (1 mark)
   A. Being praised
   B. Being paid
   C. Being treated badly because of what you believe
   D. Being taught

26. Who was stoned for standing firm in his faith? (1 mark)
   A. Peter
   B. Andrew
   C. Stephen
   D. Paul

27. The Lord's Prayer can be grouped into praise, provision, pardon and protection. Which idea is about forgiving and being forgiven? (1 mark)
   A. Protection
   B. Pardon
   C. Provision
   D. Praise

28. Which of these is a fruit of the Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Greed
   B. Kindness
   C. Jealousy
   D. Anger

29. Who helps us to make right decisions? (1 mark)
   A. Nobody
   B. Strangers
   C. The Holy Spirit
   D. Bad friends

30. Who should give permission before you use an app? (1 mark)
   A. Your parent or guardian
   B. A friend
   C. A stranger
   D. Nobody

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain how knowing that God is holy should affect the way a child behaves. (5 marks)

32. Give three reasons why we should read the Bible. (3 marks)

33. Give two examples from the Bible of people who disobeyed God. (2 marks)

34. Describe how Jesus responded when the disciples sent the children away. (3 marks)

35. Write the message of Luke 1:37 in your own words and describe a situation in which it can comfort a child. (4 marks)

36. Describe four ways in which God shows that He is a loving Father. (4 marks)

37. Name two things that can defile the body. (2 marks)

38. Explain what it means to be assertive and give an example. (4 marks)

39. Give three steps you can follow to make a right choice. (3 marks)

40. Explain how a child can show any five fruits of the Spirit in daily life. (5 marks)

41. Name two members of the extended family. (2 marks)

42. Describe four ways in which a child can stand firm in their Christian faith. (4 marks)

43. Name two ways of showing compassion to a grieving neighbour. (2 marks)

44. State two lessons from the story of Stephen. (2 marks)

45. Explain why a Christian should behave well online even when nobody is watching. (3 marks)

46. Name two people you can tell if you are touched in a way that makes you unsafe. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #11 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Parents or guardians
   Parents or guardians usually give a child a name at birth.

2. A — Make peace and forgive
   Ephesians 4:26 says not to let the sun go down on your anger.

3. D — A deep gladness that comes from knowing God loves us
   Christian joy is based on God's love, not on our circumstances.

4. A — Yes, every family that cares for a child should be respected
   Families come in different forms, and each deserves love and respect.

5. B — The person who did wrong
   It is never the child's fault.

6. C — You feel uneasy or scared
   Uneasy feelings are a signal to move away.

7. B — God is a loving Father who knows us by name
   A loving Father cares and knows us.

8. C — John
   The four Gospels are Matthew, Mark, Luke and John.

9. D — Come down, I must stay at your house today
   Luke 19:5 records Jesus asking to stay at his house.

10. B — In prison
   Joseph was in prison in Egypt.

11. B — Luke 1:76
   Luke 1:76-79 speaks about John's task.

12. A — An amazing act that shows God's power
   Miracles show God's power.

13. D — Forgiving takes courage
   Forgiveness is strong, not weak.

14. B — You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good
   Genesis 50:20 records this.

15. A — Kindness and unity
   Sharing builds love and friendship.

16. D — Telling the truth
   Righteous living pleases God.

17. D — Birds
   The birds perched in its branches.

18. D — Soil, water and light
   Seeds need soil, water and light.

19. D — Believing in Jesus and thanking God
   We respond with faith and thanks.

20. A — Psalm 125:1
   Psalm 125:1 gives this picture.

21. D — Shout for help and run to a safe place
   Shouting and running attract help.

22. B — Making things sound bigger than they are
   Exaggerating is not being truthful.

23. B — Ephesians 4:25
   Ephesians 4:25 says to put off falsehood.

24. D — Sharing your lunch
   Sharing is practical love.

25. C — Being treated badly because of what you believe
   Persecution is unfair treatment for faith.

26. C — Stephen
   Acts 7:54-60.

27. B — Pardon
   Pardon means forgiveness.

28. B — Kindness
   Kindness is listed.

29. C — The Holy Spirit
   The Spirit guides believers.

30. A — Your parent or guardian
   Ask an adult first.

SECTION B
----
31. (5 marks)
   Answer: God is pure and never does wrong, so we should respect Him, worship Him and try to be holy. We should choose good things, tell the truth, avoid sin, behave well in church and obey His commandments. If we fail, we should say sorry.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God being holy, 1 for respect, 1 for choosing good, 1 for avoiding sin or obeying, 1 for saying sorry.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: It teaches right from wrong, comforts us, helps us to know God, gives stories of people who followed God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: Adam and Eve, Jonah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each example.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: He told them to let the children come, said the kingdom belongs to them, and blessed them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

35. (4 marks)
   Answer: Nothing is impossible with God. It can comfort a child who is afraid before an exam or when a family member is very sick, because God can help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 for a suitable situation, 2 for explaining how it comforts.

36. (4 marks)
   Answer: He gives life, food, water and air; gives families; forgives when we are sorry; knows us by name; sent Jesus to save us.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 4.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: Alcohol, drugs, harmful media, sex outside marriage.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

38. (4 marks)
   Answer: Being assertive means standing for what is right calmly and firmly. Example: refusing to copy in a test and politely saying, "No, that is cheating."
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 for calm and firm, 1 for example, 1 for clear explanation.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stop and think; ask if it agrees with God's word; think about who is helped or hurt; pray; ask a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step, up to 3.

40. (5 marks)
   Answer: Love: sharing; joy: thanking God; peace: stopping quarrels; patience: waiting your turn; kindness: helping others; goodness: honesty; faithfulness: keeping promises; gentleness: speaking softly; self-control: walking away from a fight.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each fruit with an example, up to 5.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Grandfather, grandmother, uncle, aunt, cousin. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct member.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: Pray, read the Bible, say no to wrong, be proud to be a Christian, join a good church group, ask God for courage.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way up to 4.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Visit, comfort, share food, pray with them. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Be brave; forgive; trust God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: God sees everything; integrity means doing right in private; good behaviour protects us and others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Parent, guardian, teacher, pastor, nurse, police officer. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid person.
